name: manhunt-crews-backend
description: Manhunt Crews backend: public API + deadline worker on Cloud Functions for Firebase

scripts.serve:functions: npm run build && firebase --project demo-manhunt --config ../firebase.json emulators:start --only auth,firestore,storage,functions,tasks
scripts.test:integration: firebase --project demo-manhunt --config ../firebase.json emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage "vitest run tests/integration tests/security"
scripts.test:rules: firebase --project demo-manhunt --config ../firebase.json emulators:exec --only firestore,storage "vitest run tests/security/firestore-rules.test.ts"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
